description: USB-C receptacle (USB 2.0) with TPD4E05U06DQA ESD protection, CC pull-down resistors, polyfuse and zener diode on VCC. Clone of Unified Daughterboard (UDB-C) circuit, with two-layer routing. USB data lines are 0.1524 mm (6 mil) wide, below default 0.2 mm minimum track width of KiCad design rules.
